card.name: Mixed positions in warning-section phrases
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered words inside label warning phrases, such as 'the' after 'minimize', the end of 'pressure', or 'vaccines' after 'live'.

modes.label: Word endings
modes.description: Fires on the last piece of a split word in a warning phrase.

modes.label: Words after minimize or live
modes.description: Fires on a noun or 'the' that follows a verb or adjective in a precaution.
modes.example: Vaccination with live viral<< vaccines>> is not recommended before or during treatment.

card.plain: It fires on a mix of unrelated words in warning text, with no single theme.
